source.title: Profitability of simple technical trading rules of Chinese stock exchange indexes

claims.statement: Moving average is the arithmetic mean of the n most recent prices.
The variable-length moving-average position is long above the band, short below the band, flat inside it.

adaptations: Uses a deterministic synthetic fixture and a separately pinned public AAPL daily OHLCV proxy; the original Shanghai and Shenzhen index sample and performance statistics are not reproduced.
The reference engine submits a target position at signal availability and fills at the next event open, rather than asserting the paper's execution-price convention.
